stories.title: It's Election Day. Here's what you need to know
stories.titleEn: It's Election Day. Here's what you need to know
stories.summary: After a long campaign cycle, it's Election Day in the 2026 midterms. Experts expect some politicians on Tuesday night to claim the 2026 elections are rigged, but here's why that's not the case — and why it may be a while before some races are called. Race calls are a critical part of election night and NPR partners with the Associated Press to make those calls.
